name: @goldstein/library

scripts.dev: npm run ensure -w @goldstein/data && tsx scripts/build-search.ts public --if-missing && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro dev
scripts.build: npm run ensure -w @goldstein/data && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && tsx scripts/build-search.ts dist
scripts.typecheck: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json

description: The library site (Astro, static, on Cloudflare Workers static assets). See docs/sites/library.md.
